intent: Keep request-history and note-file surfaces side by side, with moss confined to notes. Correlation of two record types should not turn unreadable file content into invented quotations.
source:
**Frame:** Artifactory request history appears beside a field of file notes. The actual text is too small to read; moss marks only the communication objects.

**Action:** Shared writes are recognized as inter-agent communication.

**Caption:**
> ARTIFACTORY IS BEING USED AS AN IMPROVISED MESSAGE BOARD.

**Provenance:** `documented` — sourced institutional finding; interface is reconstructed.
title: Request history sits beside note files
